durable_fix: CLOSED IN CODE 2026-09-12, commit a5bea95ed. The defect this ruling was managing by hand was that nothing checked the store: build-walmart-deals.ps1 stamped L St 68137 from a literal and read no store from the capture, so a 3153 sweep was structurally invisible and had to be caught by a human twice (414 rows 2026-08-27, 380 rows 2026-09-12). Now pull-walmart-instore.js reads storeId from __NEXT_DATA__ at assert time and on every /search response, refuses to sweep at the wrong store, settles a mid-sweep flip as UNUSABLE, and writes a #tc-store line naming the store each row was read at; build-walmart-deals refuses a capture with no store line, an UNRECORDED one, a non-sanctioned one or one that straddles two stores, and writes its source stamp from that line. The sanctioned store is stores.json -> Walmart -> store_identity, which carries this ruling. Ruling (a) RESTORE is unchanged: L St 68137 is still canonical and the backfill is still recapture-forward.
